stealth.title: Safe Send
stealth.opis: Private PIERRON transfer via Light Protocol. You sign operations in your wallet (devnet).

guide.title: Guide
guide.subtitle: Safe Send — step by step
guide.intro: Two roles: sender sends tokens, recipient claims them. Both need a devnet wallet, this app and Light (Helius in Settings → Dev Panel).
senderSteps: Section “1. Stealth registration”: Prepare register_stealth, then Execute register on-chain.
Section “2. Recipient bundle”: Copy my recipient bundle and send to recipient.
Wait until recipient loads the bundle.
Section “3. Real send stealth”: enter amount, Prepare send_stealth, then Send on-chain.
After successful send: copy notification for recipient.
recipientSteps: Section “2. Recipient bundle”: paste bundle from sender and Load.
Section “4. Claim stealth”: paste payment notification JSON from clipboard.
Tokens arrive in wallet after confirmation.
guide.note: Notification should include lightAddressSeedHex (64 chars). Mint/RPC in Settings → Dev Panel (7× tap “Settings”).

sections.registerDesc: Prepares local stealth identity and saves keys/meta.
sections.bundleDesc: Copy your bundle or paste recipient’s. Paste JSON and tap Load.
sections.sendDesc: Anonymous 1→1 send with amount and loaded recipient bundle.
sections.claimDesc: Paste payment notification (JSON) from sender after send.
sections.debugDesc: Builder inspection, token accounts and simulations. Not the main user flow.
